reasoning: Archival data from a different cohort constitute a replication. Direct tests of competing published one-factor and two-factor findings identify the 2009 development report, 2011 dimensionality paper, and 2020 two-factor paper. The 2012 inter-rater reliability study is not separately targeted: this paper does not repeat inter-rater reliability testing. Background simulation and assessment papers are not targets. The 2009 report and 2011 paper are retained separately because this text directly attributes the tested one-factor scoring protocol to both and does not establish that they are identical publications.
